about: Hearth Settings' pages for KDE's System Settings modules (KCMs) Hearth had no page for (the owner, Nov 19, 2026: 'Build them all into Hearth Settings'). Each page: its registry entry (id, cat, label, desc, words), the KCMs it replaces, and its rows. Rows of type switch / choice / number / pick / text change file [group] key, exactly as the KCM does (the KCM's kcfg: Fedora 45, Plasma 6.8.3). hearth-kde-settings builds its allowlist from these rows; the Rust Settings app (cats/kde.rs) draws them; tools/settings-registry-rs.py adds the pages to pages_list.rs. plasma: true = only KDE Plasma uses it (saved anywhere, said on labwc).
